def apply_transformation_fixed(grid, fill_color=3, bg_color=0, pat_color=5):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    output = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(cols)] for r in range(rows)]  # Start with copy
    
    # Mark all positions that need to be 3 (fill)
    positions_to_mark = set()
    
    # Find all pattern color positions
    positions_pat = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == pat_color]
    
    # For each pair of pattern cells in the same row, fill between them
    for r in range(rows):
        cols_pat = sorted([c for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == pat_color])
        for i in range(len(cols_pat)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(cols_pat)):
                c1, c2 = cols_pat[i], cols_pat[j]
                for c in range(c1 + 1, c2):
                    positions_to_mark.add((r, c))
    
    # For each pair of pattern cells in the same column, fill between them
    for c in range(cols):
        rows_pat = sorted([r for r in range(rows) if grid[r][c] == pat_color])
        for i in range(len(rows_pat)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(rows_pat)):
                r1, r2 = rows_pat[i], rows_pat[j]
                for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):
                    positions_to_mark.add((r, c))
    
    # Apply fill color to marked positions (only if not pattern)
    for r, c in positions_to_mark:
        if output[r][c] != pat_color:
            output[r][c] = fill_color
    
    return output
